description.en: A self-playing asteroid field drifts behind the conversation, with dark frosted panels and cyan and orange accents.
description.zh: 对话后方是自动演示的小行星带,搭配深色磨砂面板,强调色为青色和橙色。

usage.en: It applies at session start. Run /deep-field to switch to it, /deep-field dim or bright to change its strength, and /deep-field off to go back to the app's own look.
usage.zh: 会话开始时自动应用。运行 /deep-field 切换到它,/deep-field dim 或 bright 调整强度,/deep-field off 恢复应用原本的外观。
